title: Lewis-Skelly misses Croatia: Rooney and Owen at the same age
checked: England v Croatia, Nations League, Wembley, Thu 12 Nov 2026 (England Football + Wikipedia). Lewis-Skelly booked v Czechia on 6 Oct, his second Nations League yellow after Prague on 29 Sep, so he misses Croatia (Dave Sport + Flashscore, both citing the Guardian; no FA statement seen). England 3-0 Czechia, XI with Lewis-Skelly in midfield (England Football + Sky). Born 26 Sep 2006 = 20y 47d on 12 Nov. Debut goal v Albania, Wembley, 21 Mar 2025, 20th minute, Bellingham's through ball, first-time left foot low through Strakosha's legs, 2-0; youngest player to score on his England debut (Sports Mole + The Star + Soccerway). Arsenal 2025-26 champions (NBC + premierleague.com). His cap count differs between sources (10 on Wikipedia, older figures elsewhere), so caps are not used; goals are. Rooney (born 24 Oct 1985): goals at his 18th, 19th, 20th birthdays 2, 9, 10, and 11 on 10 Dec 2005 = 20y 47d, from 28 caps; first goal v Macedonia in Skopje, 6 Sep 2003, aged 17y 317d, the youngest England scorer then, a first-time shot from about 25 yards (Heskey's knock-back is in one source only, so it is not named) for 1-1, England won 2-1; four goals at Euro 2004 (englandstats + Wikipedia goals list + RTE + Jim Munro). Owen (born 14 Dec 1979): debut 11 Feb 1998 v Chile aged 18y 59d, no goal; goals at 18, 19, 20 = 0, 4, 5; 5 on 30 Jan 2000; Argentina 2-2 England, Saint-Étienne, 30 Jun 1998, Owen's solo goal on 16 minutes, Argentina won 4-3 on penalties (englandstats + Wikipedia). Neither Rooney nor Owen scored on debut (englandstats, both).

lines.text: England play Croatia at Wembley next week without their youngest starter. Myles Lewis-Skelly is suspended.
lines.say: England play Croatia at Wembley next week, without their youngest starter. Myles Lewis Skelly is suspended.

scene.headline: Lewis-Skelly to miss Croatia through suspension
scene.standfirst: A second Nations League booking, against Czechia, rules the 20-year-old Arsenal man out of the Wembley game on 12 November.

lines.text: So let's do what England can't. Twenty years and forty-seven days old. How does he compare with Rooney and Owen at exactly that age?
lines.say: So let's do what England can't. Twenty years, and forty seven days old. How does he compare with Rooney and Owen, at exactly that age?

lines.text: Debut, Albania, twenty minutes in. Bellingham slides him through: left foot, goal.
lines.say: Debut, Albania, twenty minutes in. Bellingum slides him through. Left foot, goal.

lines.text: The youngest player ever to score on his England debut. Eighteen years old.
Wayne Rooney, December two thousand and five. Eleven England goals.
lines.say: Wayne Rooney, December, two thousand and five. Eleven England goals.

lines.text: The first came at seventeen, in Macedonia: first time, from twenty-five yards.
lines.say: The first came at seventeen, in Macedonia. First time, from twenty five yards.

lines.text: England's youngest ever scorer at the time. Then four more at Euro two thousand and four.
lines.say: England's youngest ever scorer, at the time. Then four more at Euro, two thousand and four.

lines.text: Michael Owen, January two thousand. He had five England goals, including the one everyone remembers.
lines.say: Michael Owen. January, two thousand. He had five England goals, including the one everyone remembers.

lines.text: Argentina, World Cup ninety-eight. Owen, eighteen, runs at the whole defence and smashes it in.
lines.say: Argentina, World Cup ninety eight. Owen, eighteen, runs at the whole defence, and smashes it in.

lines.text: Put their England goals on a graph by age, and Rooney is out of sight.
lines.say: Put their England goals on a graph by age, and Rooney is out of sight.

lines.text: But Rooney and Owen were strikers. Lewis-Skelly plays left-back or midfield.
lines.say: But Rooney and Owen were strikers. Lewis Skelly plays left back, or midfield.

lines.text: And he did one thing neither of them ever did: score on his England debut.
lines.say: And he did one thing, neither of them ever did. Score on his England debut.

lines.text: Which twenty-year-old would you pick for England? Tell me in the comments.
lines.say: Which twenty year old would you pick for England? Tell me in the comments.
